items.title: BCB launches D3 to revive domestic cricket
items.summary: Speaking at the launching ceremony at a city hotel on Sunday, BCB president Tamim Iqbal said the main objective was to restore the appeal of domestic cricket. He expressed confidence that the new competition would bring significant changes to the domestic cricket structure.

items.title: Salahuddin warns Litton and Co: ‘Upsets can happen’ against Malaysia
items.summary: Malaysia are now under the supervision of former Bangladesh coach Dav Whatmore, adding another layer of familiarity between the two sides.

items.title: Hasan, Khaled help Kent earn promotion to County Championship's top division
items.summary: Bangladesh pacers Hasan Mahmud and Khaled Ahmed played important roles in Kent’s successful promotion to Division One of the County Championship, with the English county securing a return to the top tier after a one-year absence.

items.title: Asian Games: Malaysia enter quarter-finals after washout, Oman knocked out
items.summary: Quarter-final line-ups: Afghanistan vs India, Hong Kong vs Pakistan, Bangladesh vs Malaysia and Nepal vs Sri Lanka

items.title: Litton: 'Playing Asian Games is a rare occurence'
items.summary: The Bangladesh captain is excited for his first Asiad, and said they aim to add to their gold-medal tally this time
